methods.label: Choose inputs giving 600
methods.explanation:
To use the known value \(f(500)\), choose \(x=500\). We then want \(xy=600\), so take \(y=600/500=6/5\). Both inputs are positive, as required by the identity. Therefore
\[
f(600)=\frac{f(500)}{6/5}
=3\cdot\frac56
=\boxed{\frac52}.
\]
The answer is choice \(\mathrm{C}\).
